_source: A real 'Mathematics 1 Form 2 Scheme of Work, Term 3' (a real Zambian secondary school's Mathematics Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive. This is a genuine gap fill -- this app previously had no Mathematics (Paper I) content for Form 2 at all. Cites the real official '2024 Mathematics Syllabus, Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations (pp.38-41). Covers only the term this specific document addresses (Term 3) -- Term 1 and Term 2 are not included since no source document for them was available at the time this file was built. Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.
